name: Dyresjappa

description: Dyresjappa is a family-owned pet shop located on Vogts gate at Torshov in Oslo. The store stocks food and supplies for dogs, cats, small animals and birds, including natural raw diets from Vom and MUSH. Customers can shop in store or order online with home delivery across Greater Oslo.

name: PetXL Alna
short_description: Large pet department store at Alna Senter with food and gear for dogs, cats, aquatics and reptiles.
short_description_local: Stort dyrevarehus på Alna Senter med fôr og utstyr til hund, katt, akvariefisk og reptiler.
description: PetXL Alna is a large pet specialty store located at Alna Senter on Strømsveien in Oslo. The shop features an extensive aquatics department and supplies food, crates and equipment for dogs, cats, small animals, birds and reptiles. An in-store dog grooming salon provides clipping, bathing and hand stripping services.
